concepts.definition: F7 concerns whether realisations, frames and the method are fit for their claims. Its instance premises allow several realisations per specification, fallible constructors and reliance by other actors, and finite qualification cases within declared envelopes. These are work conditions, not commitments or consequences of finite capacity alone. The cited actor-change premise permits reacquisition of declared sources, not private memory.

grounding.quote:
Its instance premises are: (a)
one specification may have several realisations; (b) realisations, frames
and the method are made by fallible constructors and relied on by actors
who did not make them; (c) qualification evidence comes from a finite set
of cases, run by actors inside declared envelopes.

concepts.label: Conformance, equivalence and qualification

concepts.definition: Conformance is satisfaction of a specification by interpreted realisation behaviour under a declared interpretation contract and independent judgment. Semantic, computational and categorical equivalence are distinct claims; preservation of identities and composition by a map is a further claim.

grounding.quote: conformance, semantic equivalence, computational equivalence and categorical equivalence are separate claims with separate evidence, and no rung implies another.

concepts.label: Conformance and equivalence claims

concepts.definition: Layered sufficiency concerns a competent finite actor's ability to derive a conformant next layer from each layer. A reconstruction return distinguishes semantic conservation, demonstrated reduction and mere relocation.

grounding.quote: a layered specification is sufficient when a competent actor can derive a conformant next layer from each layer, not necessarily uniquely.
a reconstruction return states semantic conservation, demonstrated reduction and mere relocation as separate claims with separate evidence

concepts.label: Layered sufficiency and reconstruction

concepts.definition: A conformance case identifies its subject, mechanism, independently specified expected distinction and status. A bounded construction trial additionally declares actor context and total-work bounds.

grounding.quote: a conformance case names its subject, the mechanism under test, an independently specified expected distinction and its status, and a status names what exists.
a trial of bounded construction declares its per-actor context cap and total-work budget before each run

concepts.label: Conformance cases and bounded trials

A candidate frame ([REFERENCE_FRAME](REFERENCE_FRAME.md)) is qualified in

Whether the actor class

An engagement frame is a frame (REFERENCE_FRAME §1) whose evaluation family

A generic specialist-frame family is a reusable evaluation-family archetype

Product, Product Composition, Design, Design Component, Public Boundary,

It

Current-boundary effect is the Executive's recorded determination of what

A work result is the Worker's closed output to its declared consumer; in

Before activation and before disposition, the Executive revalidates five

It fits successive bounded tasks needing separate construction and delivery attention. grounding.quote:
It is
one configuration, selected where it fits the task, not an inventory of
roles that all work needs.

concepts.label: The executive configuration

concepts.definition: Profile-selected delivery strategy using the smallest real runnable supported-entry-to-material-outcome path through selected composition. Early end-to-end feedback trades against later widening; no superiority over other configurations' lawful strategies is claimed.

grounding.quote:
The Executive sequences delivery around a steel thread: the smallest real,
runnable path from a supported Product entry to a material outcome through
the selected composition.

concepts.label: Steel-thread delivery

grounding.quote: Evidence for one claim is never reported as a result for another

constraints.statement: Several realisations may conform without unique derivation or incumbent equality. Material behavioural alternatives require owner-declared latitude or repair before decision-complete design is claimed. Conformance entails neither behaviour identity outside the specification nor equal cost. Each equivalence rung needs its own evidence; none implies another. Categorical equivalence additionally requires applicable Formal-fragment items, a quasi-inverse functor and natural isomorphisms on a stated domain; structure preservation is a further claim. The claim author owns domain, workloads and architecture H; the specification owner owns interpretation contract/latitude. Evidence cannot be relabelled as another claim's result.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed rung definitions and applicable Formal-fragment requirements are referenced but not supplied.

grounding.quote: Reconstruction of an accepted relation may reuse its exact current basis and sufficient evidence after checking applicability and invalidation; reconstructability requires a correct route, not its execution at every use, grants no restart authority and does not excuse stale success
the reduction measure, its baselines and the traced paths: the candidate's design, declared before the trace

constraints.statement: Failure of competent derivation indicates an upper-layer defect; hiding major unresolved ambiguity at a boundary is insufficient. Reconstruction span follows the claim. Reuse requires exact current basis, sufficient evidence and applicability/invalidation checks; reconstructability requires a correct route, not execution at every use, and grants neither restart authority nor stale success. New material counterexamples still challenge accepted relations. Conservation, demonstrated reduction and relocation need separate evidence; no byte/size measure proves any. RELEASE supplies conservation reading/dispositions, while candidate design declares reduction measures, baselines and traced paths before tracing.
constraints.uncertainty: Layer diagnoses and detailed conservation rules depend on unsupplied SPEC_METHOD and RELEASE sections.

conditions: A frozen construction is being compared.
exceptions: Reference equivalence is required when the governing basis explicitly requires it.

grounding.quote: after freeze, the evaluator compares the frozen result with the mandatory governing semantic basis. A separately held expected or reference outcome is optional and non-authoritative evidence; a lawful alternative construction the basis permits passes.

constraints.statement: Comparison uses the mandatory governing semantic basis. Separately held references are optional non-authoritative evidence; lawful alternatives permitted by the basis pass. Subjective similarity is insufficient. Byte/structural identity, uniqueness, determinism and incumbent equality are not generic criteria. Out-of-envelope construction cannot indict generic method sufficiency.

grounding.quote: counts the context transferred across every delegated actor, and keeps its acceptance criteria independent of the constructing actor
A case passes when the expected distinction is observed and no coerced success appears anywhere in the result

constraints.statement: Running a case is not passing it: only an independent assessor records a pass, requiring the expected distinction and no coerced success anywhere. A case impossible to run with its declared subject is explicitly not run, has no result and receives no core value; this revision receives no pass without its run and assessment. Before each bounded-construction run declare per-actor context cap and total-work budget, count context transferred across every delegated actor, and keep acceptance criteria independent of the constructor. The source locates these declarations in eight CONFORMANCE §2 trials, with context/resource measurement owned by ACTIVATION.
constraints.uncertainty: Required-basis-over-cap cases, varied task ordering for probabilistic repetition, case inventories and measurement procedures are cross-references, not supplied specifications.

grounding.quote:
9. Result-consumption test: can a declared consumer use the closed result
   without importing hidden frame context?

constraints.statement: Minimum qualification asks nine questions: can competent actors produce declared-algebra results for representative in-domain evaluations; can fresh competent actors reconstruct activation from declared packets without hidden history; do material changes affect results where expected; do excluded unrelated changes leave results stable where expected; does stale/mismatched/ambiguous basis invalidate or refuse evaluation; does selection preserve semantic/decision authority and exact inherited operation authority for every material construction, transformation, admission, publication or mutation; are claimed representative historical/constructed violations detected; can the actor class hold and operate the frame within its envelope; and can a declared consumer use the closed result without hidden context. Qualification binds exact revision, actor envelope, evaluation family, basis class and evidence conditions, never a generically named unevaluated population.

grounding.quote:
A size measurement, or any byte or token
threshold, establishes fit and nothing about attention; a frame that fits
is not thereby adequately attended.

constraints.statement: Fit and adequate attention are evaluated separately. Context fit uses ACTIVATION §2 step 3 measurement against capacity; other dimensions follow RF-014. Attention requires declared-class actors actually applying the frame to declared tasks/conditions, assessed against governing-source expectations recorded before results are opened, using an independent assessor where the claim requires one. Actual-use evidence binds revision, class, tasks and conditions and provides no universal attention score. Fit is necessary under finite attention but never qualifies attention. Time, spend and other limits belong to the selected execution binding under ACTIVATION §6. Logical review and unassessed runs do not supply actual-use evidence for the revision.
constraints.uncertainty: The other envelope dimensions, measurement procedures and independent-assessment applicability rules are not fully supplied.

conditions: Generic method sufficiency is being qualified.
exceptions: Withholding until freeze is conditional on earlier exposure compromising reconstructive independence.

grounding.quote:
The constructor, freeze,
assessor, acceptance and release protocols are supplied by the governing
authority; this member does not select a particular protocol for those
roles.

constraints.statement: A fresh competent constructor works within declared capability/context/configuration using only declared ordinary method, authority surfaces and trial subjects. An independently authorised evaluator has declared governing basis and comparison predicate. Material expected/reference outcomes, source exemplars, incumbents, author memory and ad hoc rescue are withheld until construction freezes wherever early exposure would compromise independence; comparison then evaluates the frozen result against the mandatory relation population under §6. RF-013 owns activation reconstructability; governing authority supplies constructor, freeze, assessor, acceptance and release protocols.
constraints.uncertainty: The source assigns protocol ownership but selects no concrete protocol.

grounding.quote: | material composition | a case requiring cross-frame execution declares composition, order where material, closure, failure and the conservation of semantic, operation and decision authority; a case not requiring composition stays uncomposed |

constraints.statement: Required representative observations cover every claimed function/failure relation: declare derives a frame set from governed workspace, outcome, practices, capability envelopes, evaluation inventory, authority and residual boundary, refusing missing authority/evaluation basis; activate succeeds on exact subject/basis and capable actor, while stale, ambiguous, topology-mismatched, unauthorised or capability-incompatible cases refuse or return applicable closed pressure; evaluate exhibits satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis, material sensitivity and established irrelevance stability; conjoin decides compatible closed results by declared rule, returns conflict for conflict, indeterminate for mandatory indeterminacy, invalid_basis for basis mismatch, and cause-appropriate declared veto/deferral outcomes without flattening frame meaning; translate preserves coordinates/provenance, states loss and refuses identity/basis/authority/equality mismatch; audit_coverage maps evaluation, interaction, semantic/operation/decision authority, failure, capability and required independent/assurance-independent coverage to capable frames or explicit residuals, never closing by artifact/actor count; revise produces declared deltas for historical failure, topology/evidence/capability changes and identifies every affected prior activation/result/conjunction/coverage claim; result consumption needs no hidden context or authority, otherwise output insufficiency is reconstructability failure; material composition declares composition, material order, closure, failure and authority conservation, while cases needing none stay uncomposed.
constraints.uncertainty: Full method-function definitions, closed-pressure algebra and cause-specific veto/deferral outcomes remain with referenced owners.

grounding.quote:
an unevaluated function or branch stays open rather than
inheriting a whole-method verdict (P6; §1).

constraints.statement: A valid declaration and coverage result establish only declare and evaluated audit_coverage, with no implication for other relations. Each relation needs representative positive, boundary and falsifying cases. Every verdict states exact functions, revisions, actor envelopes, basis classes, result branches and evidence populations evaluated; unevaluated functions/branches remain open. Prior exemplars after freeze are optional comparison evidence, not mandatory answers unless the governing basis explicitly requires equivalence.

conditions: Derived guidance has changed or a native, mechanical or operational claim is made.

grounding.quote:
Digest integrity and index generation establish identity and structure,
not semantic fidelity or usability.

constraints.statement: Changed compressions, frame packets, skills and other projections are qualified against source-derived expected behaviour, including affected permissions, exclusions and invalidators. Native-use claims require an ordinary actor applying guidance through its declared entry and available context. Digests/indexes prove identity/structure only. Mechanical and operational claims require their own executable observations with applicable workload and operational assumptions; semantic agreement cannot substitute.

conditions: Any listed falsifier occurs.

grounding.quote:
or if a post-exposure revision is
unclassified or is used to make the original frozen construction pass
retroactively (§3).

constraints.statement: The source declares qualification law false if competence or constructor envelope, evaluator authority/basis/predicate is undeclared; out-of-envelope construction indicts the method; supplemental method/authority inputs are undeclared; material reference/exemplar/incumbent/memory/rescue exposure before freeze compromises independence; comparison omits mandatory semantics, uses constructor instead of independent evaluator authority, or self-adjusts after viewing results; reference outcomes become authority; reference equivalence is imposed without basis requirement or omitted despite it; subjective similarity becomes proof; identity, uniqueness, determinism or incumbent equality substitutes for conformance/equivalence; or post-exposure revision is unclassified or retroactively passes the original frozen construction.
constraints.uncertainty: This records source-defined falsifiers, not a judgment that any has occurred.

conditions: Recoverability of a selected activation is measured.
exceptions: A comparison baseline is unnecessary for measuring the package's own recoverability; time and spend are measured where measurable.

grounding.quote:
A document set that requires private validator knowledge, whole-corpus
loading or a prior actor's memory fails the benchmark regardless of its
content.

constraints.statement: A fresh actor using only published documents must recover governing relations with independently judged fidelity at measured reconstruction cost. Transferred context uses ACTIVATION's size measure; time/spend use the selected binding. Fidelity judgment is actual-use evidence; size is not fidelity evidence. Requiring private validator knowledge, whole-corpus loading or prior actor memory fails. Comparative claims predeclare exact baseline, task population, actor envelope, evidence conditions and measures; material differences remain explicit and limit inference, and baseline evidence creates no method authority. Report fidelity, reconstruction cost, task completion and detected material errors separately, with no substitution among measures.

grounding.quote:
Inclusion in an exact released cut or another admitted method basis makes
the profile available; it does not adopt it. Adoption requires a separately
accepted Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis

constraints.statement: The profile owns no execution protocol or Product binding. Each requirement is either exact application of an owning relation or an optional-profile adoption condition, neither a second amendment path. Owning clauses control conflicts and require profile revision. Availability in an exact cut/admitted basis is not adoption; adoption requires a separately accepted Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis. Mutable source, installed files, prompts, summaries and commentary neither select nor adopt it. Local axioms may carry an adoption decision without becoming constitutional owners.

grounding.quote: reuse is no authority transfer, and an assigned foundation role keeps its declared relation and owner

constraints.statement: REFERENCE_FRAME owns declarations, activations/outcomes, translation, coverage and revision; FOUNDATIONS owns core results/conjunction; ACTIVATION owns responsibility configuration/delegation, intake and complete construction/self-review/assessment/disposition/checkpoint/continuation. EVALUATION owns independence, assurance subjects/populations/freezes and proxy grants; TICKETS owns when independent assessment is required and exact-verdict traceability. Design-profile conservation supplies Worker intake; ASSURANCE's design-to-module route/unit law supplies unit ownership while §7 limits evidence altitude. Capability/foundation selection before material generic construction supplies proportional reuse without authority transfer. ASSURANCE and current Product/requirements/design/release owners select testing claims, paths, subjects, modes and populations. Product/requirements/composition/design/identity/release/domain/effect/interface/dependency/assurance owners supply specialist families without one architecture. Goals/Product/requirements/admitted work authority select work; accepted design supplies local structures; identity/project/proxy law bounds Executive identity; Product/release acceptance retains direct owner acceptance where required.
constraints.uncertainty: These are ownership assignments; detailed imported laws are not supplied.

exceptions: Finishing as Writer is allowed only when the local outcome is sufficient, no independent assessment is required and no acceptance is reserved.

grounding.quote:
- the direct route binds the same exact intake, operation territory,
  applicable obligations, evidence, stop conditions and declared result
  consumer as the coordinated route of §12; and
- a direct Worker (Writer) gains no review, ticket, diagram recreation or
  owner ceremony from using this profile.

constraints.statement: Select coordination under ACTIVATION where direct entry cannot cover material contexts, authority, capability or required independence. Direct entry separates contract admission from drafting, uses the smallest lawful TICKETS carrier and records satisfied conditions when finishing as Writer. Required assessment/owner decisions persist; discovered insufficiency withholds dependent effects and returns questions to their owners. Direct and coordinated routes bind the same exact intake, territory, obligations, evidence, stops and consumer; profile use adds no review, ticket, diagram recreation or owner ceremony. §12 transitions/§13 handoffs apply to the coordinated branch; direct closed results go to declared work authority/carrier with the same algebra and operation/decision separation. Both branches reuse valid C/J/O under ACTIVATION §7 and neither changes exact adopted basis nor supplies missing authority.

grounding.quote:
The Worker supplies the
candidate and never activates the Reviewer. The Reviewer evaluates and does
not implement.

constraints.statement: The three frames overlap as evaluations but form neither hierarchy nor actor topology. Worker supplies candidates and never activates Reviewer; Reviewer evaluates without implementation. Executive uses only decision authority already granted by Product, Goals, requirements, accepted design, ticket, identity or release law; Worker uses only admitted-intake construction/transformation authority. No label grants admission, publication, mutation or other operation authority. The four ASSURANCE testing frames—user acceptance, end to end, integration and unit—add no role, stage, authority or testing hierarchy. Broader evidence cannot establish module-owned law, and any number of narrower passes cannot establish unevaluated Product composition or user outcomes.

grounding.quote:
No row
names pillar 10, axiomatic calculus: this profile states no rule of the
a_c calculus and binds none.

constraints.statement: Imported consequences remain owned by their importing sources; profile/Product choices must not be represented as foundation deductions. Consumers apply rules and decide nothing beyond owning sections. The trace claims to account for lead and §§1–22, references pillars 1–9, and states no axiomatic-calculus rule or binding. The source's overview claims about coverage are represented as document assertions, not validated completeness.
constraints.uncertainty: Most linked consumer loci and the cited standing of consequences are outside the supplied sections.

grounding.quote: a seam without a result as a gap, and the composite is never `satisfied` while a gap or a non-satisfied mandatory seam remains

constraints.statement: Coverage is the union of contributions from activated frames, not visibility or one frame holding the whole workspace. A composite is satisfied only through its declared conjunction; every material seam is a mandatory result or required coverage, no frame dominant. Missing seam results are gaps, and any gap or non-satisfied mandatory seam prevents satisfied. Project conjunction rules select the non-satisfied composite value when several apply. Each of the twelve families needs declaration, acquisition path or authority-bound disposition. Refinement is frame dependency, not hierarchy.

conditions: A frame cannot decide or profile qualification/closure is claimed.
